'''Null hockey''' was a hockey game played<ref name="TNR" /> in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> which used zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] conditions. The game utilized a puck, which was bounced off walls.<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Null hockey was mentioned in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', a [[1996]] novel by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
